baseline: the anchor: HybridAnchored without LLM, 0.80 market and 0.20 Valve rating logit (`debate::base`)

candidates.name: rating_calibration
candidates.description: Valve rating's map probability rescaled in logit space by a factor fitted per series format, then blended with the market as the anchor does
candidates.reason: the interval of the log-loss difference includes zero

candidates.name: learned_weights
candidates.description: the anchor's market and Valve rating weights (logit space) learned by the combiner on the Events that ended before, one set per availability of the two inputs, regularised towards 0.80 / 0.20
candidates.reason: the interval of the log-loss difference includes zero

candidates.name: market_source_pinnacle
candidates.description: the anchor with Pinnacle's last price before the cutoff as the market, on Matches every source priced
candidates.reason: computed on 19 paired Matches, under the floor of 100

candidates.name: market_source_polymarket
candidates.description: the anchor with Polymarket's last price before the cutoff as the market, on Matches every source priced
candidates.reason: computed on 19 paired Matches, under the floor of 100

candidates.name: market_source_kalshi
candidates.description: the anchor with Kalshi's last price before the cutoff as the market, on Matches every source priced
candidates.reason: computed on 19 paired Matches, under the floor of 100

candidates.name: market_source_average
candidates.description: the anchor with the mean of Pinnacle, Polymarket and Kalshi as the market, on Matches every source priced
candidates.reason: computed on 19 paired Matches, under the floor of 100

candidates.name: line_movement
candidates.description: the anchor's logit moved by how the line moved (closing against opening, and closing against six hours before the cutoff), coefficients fitted walk-forward
candidates.reason: computed on 24 paired Matches, under the floor of 100

candidates.name: favourite_longshot
candidates.description: the market's price rescaled in logit space by a factor fitted walk-forward on earlier Events (favourite-longshot bias), then blended as the anchor does
candidates.reason: computed on 24 paired Matches, under the floor of 100

candidates.name: own_rating
candidates.description: Glicko-2 team rating updated after every Match finished before the cutoff (teams joined by team_key), with format-calibrated map scale blended with the market as the anchor does
candidates.reason: the interval of the log-loss difference includes zero

candidates.name: recent_form
candidates.description: Recent results over the last 45 days (14-day half-life) weighted by opponent strength from the point-in-time Glicko-2 rating, added as a fitted logit offset to the anchor
candidates.reason: the interval of the log-loss difference includes zero

candidates.name: head_to_head
candidates.description: Recency-weighted head-to-head series record between the two teams (180-day half-life, shrunk toward even), added as a fitted logit offset to the anchor
candidates.reason: computed on 64 paired Matches, under the floor of 100

candidates.name: llm_adjustment
candidates.description: The three-seat debate's adjustment (HybridAnchored, debate mode `always`, the first seating) on the Matches with a roster flag, from recorded answers
candidates.reason: no LLM answers in this run; produce them with `cargo run -p kallbet-ai -- lab --llm <LLM_FILE> --answers <ANSWERS_FILE> --budget claude=<RUNS> --budget codex=<RUNS> --budget antigravity=<RUNS>`

candidates.name: lineup_strength
candidates.description: Mean HLTV player rating of the 5 playing starters from the pre-cutoff Liquipedia roster (90-day half-life, shrunk toward prior 1.00 with weight 6 maps; debutants/unknown stand-ins take the 1.00 prior when at least 3 of 5 starters on each team have HLTV history, else uncovered), added as a fitted logit offset to the anchor
candidates.reason: the archive holds no HLTV player statistics records (hltv/), so lineup strength cannot be evaluated

candidates.name: player_form
candidates.description: Mean recent-minus-longer-run HLTV rating form of the 5 playing starters from the pre-cutoff Liquipedia roster (30d/14d half-life vs 180d/90d half-life, shrunk toward neutral 0.0 with weight 4 maps; debutants/players without 2+ baseline & recent Matches take 0.0 when at least 3 of 5 starters on each team have form, else uncovered), added as a fitted logit offset to the anchor
candidates.reason: the archive holds no HLTV player statistics records (hltv/), so player form cannot be evaluated

candidates.name: per_map_rating
candidates.description: Per-map Elo from completed Liquipedia series, averaged over equally likely map sets and blended with the market
candidates.reason: No played Liquipedia maps linked to completed PandaScore Matches in the archive

candidates.name: bo1_veto_sim
candidates.description: Bo1 ban simulation from past HLTV vetoes and map results, blended with the market
candidates.reason: No complete HLTV Bo1 vetoes linked to finished PandaScore Matches in the archive

candidates.name: roster_stand_in
candidates.description: A stand-in in the active five, from the pre-cutoff Liquipedia revision.
candidates.reason: the interval of the log-loss difference includes zero

candidates.name: roster_change_30d
candidates.description: An active-five change bounded to the last 30 days by dated lineup observations.
candidates.reason: computed on 14 paired Matches, under the floor of 100

candidates.name: roster_stability
candidates.description: Days since the current five was first observed after a different five.
candidates.reason: the interval of the log-loss difference includes zero

candidates.name: roster_coach_change
candidates.description: An emergency coach substitute or a change from the previously observed active coach set.
candidates.reason: computed on 69 paired Matches, under the floor of 100

candidates.name: rest_schedule_load
candidates.description: Team differences in rest, Matches and maps in the preceding 48 hours, and a second Match on the same UTC day
candidates.reason: the interval of the log-loss difference includes zero

candidates.name: stakes
candidates.description: Pre-round Swiss records, advancement and elimination Matches, and Playoffs rounds
candidates.reason: better overall, but worse on the Matches with a market line (+0.0086)

candidates.name: lan_online
candidates.description: Team win rates in the current environment, with separate weights for LAN and online
candidates.reason: the interval of the log-loss difference includes zero

candidates.name: series_format
candidates.description: Team differences in Bo1 versus Bo3 performance, conditioned on the current format
candidates.reason: the interval of the log-loss difference includes zero

candidates.name: region_travel
candidates.description: Difference in playing a LAN outside the team's published VRS qualifying region
candidates.reason: computed on no Match: it needs a dated LAN host region and dated VRS qualifying regions for both teams, plus 20 anchored training Matches
